definition: means an identified section, ward or wing of a hospital which is under the constant supervision of a dedicated medical practitioner(s), and which is specially equipped for the continuous monitoring and treatment of patients who are in a critical condition, or require life support facilities and where the level of care and supervision is considerably more sophisticated and intensive than in the ordinary and other wards.
plain: A dedicated hospital section with the equipment and specially trained staff for continuous monitoring of critically ill patients.
whyItMatters: The definition matters when an insurer decides whether ICU rates applied legitimately. Where a policy caps ICU separately, whether a bed counts as ICU under this definition decides which limit your bill is measured against.
